review.note: Previously approved 2026-09-05 (endurance_performance goal-list fix). Re-flagged 2026-09-06: dietaryProteinAdequacy is no longer a self-reported answer — the intake form's separate 'do you feel you get enough protein?' question was removed and this field is now DERIVED from the numeric protein estimate via a single goal-independent threshold (>=1.2g/kg bodyweight = adequate; see ADEQUATE_PROTEIN_G_PER_KG in lib/intake/assemble-profile.ts). This policy's own `neq likely_adequate` check is unaffected in shape, but its practical trigger rate will shift, and the 1.2g/kg cutoff (vs. a higher, goal-specific one up to 2.0g/kg for muscle-gain-type goals) hasn't been domain-validated. Needs re-review before this can go back to expert_reviewed.
